description: Oscillator crossfading between three waveforms you draw by hand, through a multimode filter and a level stage

params.text: Sets how far the points either side of a dragged point follow it, the pull falling to under two thirds at each step away; at zero only the dragged point moves
Sets the cutoff of the filter
Sets the resonance of the filter
Picks the filter: off, low pass, high pass, band pass or notch

inputs.text: Sets the pitch, a volt per octave with 0V giving 32.7Hz and voltages above 8V clamped; an empty jack reads 4V
Crossfades between the three drawn waveforms, -5V for the first, 0V for the second and 5V for the third, despite the panel printing -10V, 0V and 10V
Attenuates the filter cutoff knob, 10V leaving the knob where it is and 0V closing the filter; an empty jack reads 10V
Attenuates the filter resonance knob, 10V leaving the knob where it is; an empty jack reads 10V
Attenuates the level knob, 10V leaving the knob where it is and 0V silencing the output; an empty jack reads 10V
While Solo is on, a rising edge here steps to the next of the three waveforms

notes: a new module is silent twice over: all three waveforms come up flat, and the LEVEL knob comes up fully counter-clockwise
draw a waveform in the display, or step through the built-in shapes with the Presets arrows, to give the oscillator something to play
the Wave 1, 2 and 3 buttons pick which of the three waveforms the display shows and edits
with Draw off, dragging a point moves that one point, and the Rubber Band knob pulls its neighbours with it; with Draw on, dragging across the display sets every point the pointer crosses
right-clicking a point in the display returns it to the middle of the range
holding Control while dragging a point moves it in much finer steps
Solo plays the shown waveform alone, ignoring the Morph input
Invert turns the shown waveform upside down and Rand replaces every point with a random one
Copy, then a click on another Wave button, gives that waveform the shape of the one shown

inputs.5: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
